services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Ignite imagination and spark curiosity with our grade-specific programs aligned with the Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS) taught in your classrooms. Our interactive science center is thoughtfully designed to inspire young minds to explore the exciting world of science, technology, engineering, art, and math (STEAM). Our Field Trips offer immersive, educational experiences tailored for elementary and middle school students. From interactive exhibits to engaging workshops led by our expert educators, your students will have the opportunity to explore STEAM concepts in a fun and memorable way. Let us help you create a field trip that your students will be talking about all year long!

services.name: Helicopter Tours
services.desc: Discover Orange County from above! Kids hop in this helicopter inspired theater and watch real footage of Orange County from an aerial view. Soar through the skies above one of Southern California’s most incredible outdoor spaces, the Irvine Ranch Natural Landmarks. Filled with unparalleled biodiversity, this 40,000 acre landscape is right in our backyard! Energy fuels our lives every day. Learn how different elements will help play a key role in providing the consistent and affordable energy we have all become accustomed to.
